package syncer

import (
	"net"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"testing/synctest"
	"time"

	"github.com/alcaprophet/cloudhost-firewall-autoupdater/config"
	"github.com/alcaprophet/cloudhost-firewall-autoupdater/dns"
	"github.com/alcaprophet/cloudhost-firewall-autoupdater/notifier"
	"github.com/alcaprophet/cloudhost-firewall-autoupdater/provider"
)

// 每个 Syncer 独立登记接缝；只在临时测试构建中存在，不修改生产结构或公开 API。
var i8r18StopGates sync.Map

type i8r18StopGateProbe struct {
	entry string
	hits  atomic.Int32
}

func i8r18BeforeStopGate(s *Syncer, entry string) {
	if value, ok := i8r18StopGates.Load(s); ok {
		probe := value.(*i8r18StopGateProbe)
		if probe.entry == entry {
			probe.hits.Add(1)
			s.Stop()
		}
	}
}

// TestI8R18InjectedStopGate 在具体入口选中后、门控判定前确定性停止。
func TestI8R18InjectedStopGate(t *testing.T) {
	for _, entry := range []string{"startup", "ticker", "trigger", "resume"} {
		t.Run(entry, func(t *testing.T) {
			synctest.Test(t, func(t *testing.T) {
				st := gatedState(t, entry != "resume", time.Hour)
				p := newProbeProvider(config.CloudTCCVM, 0)
				st.Providers = []provider.Provider{p}
				s := New(NewRuntimeManager(st))
				s.resolveHostFn = func(string) ([]dns.ResolvedIP, error) {
					return []dns.ResolvedIP{{IP: net.ParseIP("192.0.2.18")}}, nil
				}
				events, cancel := s.EventBus().SubscribeChan()
				defer cancel()
				probe := &i8r18StopGateProbe{entry: entry}
				i8r18StopGates.Store(s, probe)
				done := make(chan struct{})
				go func() {
					s.Run()
					close(done)
				}()
				t.Cleanup(func() {
					s.Stop()
					select {
					case <-done:
					case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
						t.Error("Stop 夹具清理未等到 Run 退出")
					}
					i8r18StopGates.Delete(s)
				})
				synctest.Wait()
				switch entry {
				case "ticker":
					synctest.Sleep(time.Hour)
				case "trigger":
					s.TriggerSync()
				case "resume":
					s.Resume()
				}
				synctest.Wait()
				// 等待实际 Run 返回，允许错误变体完成真实目标冷却后再断言。
				// 此处不主动 Stop：退出必须由目标入口的测试接缝触发。
				select {
				case <-done:
				case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
					t.Fatal("Stop 门控夹具未有界退出；不能作为行为负向控制成功")
				}
				if got := probe.hits.Load(); got != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("Stop 门控接缝未准确命中一次：%s=%d", entry, got)
				}
				wantRounds := 0
				if entry == "ticker" || entry == "trigger" {
					wantRounds = 1
				}
				starts, completes := 0, 0
			drain:
				for {
					select {
					case event := <-events:
						switch event.Type {
						case notifier.EventSyncStart:
							starts++
						case notifier.EventSyncComplete:
							completes++
						}
					default:
						break drain
					}
				}
				if starts != wantRounds || completes != wantRounds {
					t.Errorf("I8R18_BEHAVIOR %s：实际轮次 start=%d complete=%d，want=%d", entry, starts, completes, wantRounds)
				}
				if p.snapshotCalls != wantRounds*2 {
					t.Errorf("I8R18_BEHAVIOR %s：Provider 快照=%d，want=%d", entry, p.snapshotCalls, wantRounds*2)
				}
				if p.createCalls != wantRounds || p.deleteCalls != 0 {
					t.Errorf("I8R18_BEHAVIOR %s：Provider 新增=%d 删除=%d，want=%d/0", entry, p.createCalls, p.deleteCalls, wantRounds)
				}
				if !s.IsEnabled() {
					t.Error("Stop 不得改变已发布的 enabled 状态")
				}
				if s.Status().Running {
					t.Error("Run 返回后 running 必须为 false")
				}
				t.Logf("entry=%s 接缝=%d 轮次=%d/%d 快照=%d 新增=%d 删除=%d", entry, probe.hits.Load(), starts, completes, p.snapshotCalls, p.createCalls, p.deleteCalls)
			})
		})
	}
}
